title: Email Privacy & Encryption Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your email privacy risk score. Assess encryption, provider security, and habits to protect your communications from surveillance.
description: Evaluate your email privacy and security posture with our comprehensive risk assessment. Get personalized recommendations to improve your email encryption and protect sensitive communications.

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates email privacy risk based on provider security, encryption usage, authentication methods, password strength, and communication habits. Scores are weighted to reflect real-world privacy threats.
tips: Switch to privacy-focused email providers like ProtonMail or Tutanota for better security
Enable two-factor authentication on all email accounts immediately
Use PGP encryption for sensitive communications, even with secure providers
Avoid checking email on public WiFi or use Incognito Browser with VPN
Create strong, unique passwords and consider using a password manager
Set up email aliases to compartmentalize different aspects of your digital life
Regularly audit email account permissions and connected third-party apps
Consider using Tor Browser or Incognito Browser for accessing email anonymously

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good email privacy practices. Continue monitoring and stay updated on new threats.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy vulnerabilities exist. Consider upgrading your email provider and enabling encryption.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy risks. Immediate action needed: switch providers, enable 2FA, and start encrypting emails.
